0022600109.text: The Spurs visit Dallas at 0-1 after a loss, sitting fifth in the Southwest and 12th in the West, while the Mavericks are 1-1, riding a one-game winning streak, and third in the Southwest and ninth in the West. San Antonio is without Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), and Dallas is missing Cooper Flagg (shoulder, soreness) and Dereck Lively II (foot, surgery), with Caleb Martin, Jett Howard, Santi Aldama and Tarik Biberovic listed as day-to-day and game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet this season, and the Spurs won all four meetings in 2025-26, most recently 139-120 in San Antonio on April 10, 2026.
